def bounded_sends(cap: int, n: int) -> int:
    """Sends that fit in a channel of capacity cap when n sends are attempted into an empty channel."""
    pre cap >= 0
    pre n >= 0
    post out <= cap
    post out <= n
    ex bounded_sends(3, 5) == 3
    ex bounded_sends(0, 4) == 0
    ex bounded_sends(4, 2) == 2
    if cap < n:
        return cap
    return n

def accepted(cap: int, xs: list[int]) -> int uses nondet:
    """Create a channel of capacity cap, try to send each element of xs without blocking, and return how many sends were accepted before the channel was full. Sending stops at the first rejected send."""
    pre cap >= 0
    post out >= 0
    post out <= cap
    post out <= xs.len()
    return bounded_sends(cap=cap, n=xs.len())
